actions.ai_create_record.description: Creates a Fireberry record from a JSON object of field values.
actions.ai_create_record.props.fields.de: JSON object of field system names to values.
actions.ai_create_record.props.objectSys: System name of the Fireberry object type, as returned by List Object Types (e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity, Cases). The numeric objectType (e.g. 1 for Account, 2 for Contact) is also accepted.
actions.ai_delete_record.props.objectSys: System name of the Fireberry object type, as returned by List Object Types (e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity, Cases). The numeric objectType (e.g. 1 for Account, 2 for Contact) is also accepted.
actions.ai_get_record.description: Gets one Fireberry record by its ID.
actions.ai_get_record.props.objectSystem: System name of the Fireberry object type, as returned by List Object Types (e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity, Cases). The numeric objectType (e.g. 1 for Account, 2 for Contact) is also accepted.
actions.ai_list_object_fields.descriptio: Lists the fields of a Fireberry object type with their system names and types.
actions.ai_list_object_fields.props.obje: System name of the Fireberry object type, as returned by List Object Types (e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity, Cases). The numeric objectType (e.g. 1 for Account, 2 for Contact) is also accepted.
actions.ai_list_object_types.description: Lists the object types (Account, Contact, custom objects...) available in the Fireberry account.
actions.ai_list_picklist_values.descript: Lists the allowed values of a Fireberry picklist field.
actions.ai_list_picklist_values.props.fi: System name of the picklist field, as returned by List Object Fields (e.g. statuscode).
actions.ai_list_picklist_values.props.ob: System name of the Fireberry object type, as returned by List Object Types (e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity, Cases). The numeric objectType (e.g. 1 for Account, 2 for Contact) is also accepted.
actions.ai_search_records.description: Searches records of a Fireberry object type with a Fireberry query.
actions.ai_search_records.props.fields.d: Field system names to return. Leave empty to return all fields.
actions.ai_search_records.props.objectSy: System name of the Fireberry object type, as returned by List Object Types (e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity, Cases). The numeric objectType (e.g. 1 for Account, 2 for Contact) is also accepted.
actions.ai_search_records.props.query.de: Fireberry query, e.g. (emailaddress1 = 'a@b.com'). Leave empty to list all records.
actions.ai_search_records.props.sortBy.d: Field system name to sort by (e.g. modifiedon).
actions.ai_update_record.description: Updates fields of an existing Fireberry record.
actions.ai_update_record.props.fields.de: JSON object of field system names to new values. Use null to clear a field.
actions.ai_update_record.props.objectSys: System name of the Fireberry object type, as returned by List Object Types (e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity, Cases). The numeric objectType (e.g. 1 for Account, 2 for Contact) is also accepted.
actions.create_record.description: Create a new record in Fireberry.
actions.delete_record.props.confirmDelet: Check this box to confirm you want to permanently delete the selected records. This action cannot be undone.
actions.find_record.props.pageNumber.des: Page number to retrieve (1-10). Fireberry serves only the first 10 pages; larger values use 10.
actions.find_record.props.pageSize.descr: Number of records to return (1-50). Larger values use 50.
actions.find_record.props.searchQuery.de: Fireberry query syntax, e.g. (accountname = 'Acme') or (emailaddress1 start-with 'john'). Combine conditions with and / or. Leave empty to get all records.
actions.find_record.props.sortBy.descrip: System name of field to sort by (e.g., "createdon", "accountname")
actions.update_record.description: Update an existing record in Fireberry. Empty fields keep their current value.
auth.description: Enter your Fireberry API token. In Fireberry open Settings (gear icon) > Integration > API Forms (API token) and copy the token. The token acts with the permissions of the user it belongs to.
triggers.record_created_or_updated.descr: Fires when a record is created or updated in Fireberry.
triggers.record_created_or_updated.props: No longer used. The trigger now tracks Fireberry timestamps; kept so existing flows still load.
